note: Small City of Rock Rapids park at the west edge of town on Hwy 9/75, with disc golf, sand volleyball, a playground, a picnic shelter and an 1871 log cabin. The camper pads are a short gravel row off the park road beside the highway. --Claude
summary: Sites 8, facilities (showers, flush toilets), FCFS envelope booking and the $20 fee confirmed from the city's camping page; fees checked stamped 2024 (the posted rate is still the 2024 season's). Not waterfront confirmed. PIN ~230 m off. Note trimmed.
flags: HOOKUPS: the city page says the 8 sites have 'electrical hookups with water and sewer available' but gives no amperage, and the wording may mean water and a dump station rather than per-site hookups (its own rules say 'Tank water shall be disposed in the designated dump station areas only'). Nothing written to hookups.
FEES: the only posted rate is labelled '2024 Camping season' ($20), and no later rate is posted, so fees.checked is set to 2024 to show its age.
PIN: stored 43.42950,-96.18250 is on the ballfields south of the park, ~230 m from the pads. Correct to 43.4315,-96.1830, the camper-pad row on Esri imagery just south of Hwy 9/75.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. On imagery the pads sit between the highway and town houses, with no water within the 600 m frame; the Rock River is not near the sites.
FIT: the pads look ~15-17 m (50+ ft) long on imagery, with campers on them; the city posts no length limit. Fits 23 ft.
SEASON: the city posts no season dates ('Camping season' only), so season is left unknown.
